678-4939-8250.description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary.
When Burning-Tree Emissary dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax.
Repeat.

2226-2499-5125.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2499-5125.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sparkcaster by paying its mana cost.
When Sparkcaster enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

3899-5254-5902.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3899-5254-5902.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

728-1808-2837.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-1808-2837.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first Eloise trigger, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the second Eloise trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

628-4247-7187.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Hovel Hurler.
When Hovel Hurler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

323-1981-2415-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
323-1981-2415-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3532-5078-6556-7864.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1895-4399-4518-6720.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4518-6720.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3132-3259-7060.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
3132-3259-7060.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3132-3259-7060.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1621-1739-2146-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

4742-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4742-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4742-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

3490-4050-4716-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-4716-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1978-7290-7685.description:
Animate Arc Reactor using Does Machines.
Activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arc Reactor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-4350-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Butcher Ghoul enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2921-4350-6972.notes: If Butcher Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

141-2292-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 5.

1453-2034-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-2034-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2060-2744-5660-6797--29.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with mana value 1 or less
2060-2744-5660-6797--29.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 1 or less from your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
2060-2744-5660-6797--29.notes: This combo will not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler unless the creature has mana value 0.

483-997-4681-5170.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1183-1306-4853.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Mana Crypt.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

147-2511-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2228-3108-5400.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Synth Infiltrator.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Synth Infiltrator by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

339-677-997-2079.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Temur Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2577-2741-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-2741-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

586-2438-5060-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
586-2438-5060-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1636-2300-3107-3653.easyPrerequisites: You have created a Treasure token this turn.
1636-2300-3107-3653.description:
Activate Vazi by tapping it, causing an opponent to create at least one Treasure token.
The Treasure(s) enter the battlefield as a 0/0 creature and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Intruder Alarm and Disciple of the Vault that many times.
Resolve all Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve all Disciple of the Vault triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

276-1495-4120.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat as desired.
276-1495-4120.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

407-2400-2903.notablePrerequisites: You control at least nine Swamps.
407-2400-2903.description:
Activate Cabal Coffers by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {B} for each Swamp you control.
Cast Leshrac's Sigil by paying {B}{B}.
Onyx Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Cabal Coffers.
Activate Leshrac's Sigil by paying {B}{B}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3769-3967-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
3769-3967-5434-5555.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim. Blim triggers, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Yahenni by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

366-1339-3311.notablePrerequisites:
Snake Umbra attached to Purphoros.
You have a way to draw a card.
366-1339-3311.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Purphoros, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Snake Umbra triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

4694-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that is boosting the toughness of all your creatures by at least 1, or that is giving a creature a +1/+1 counter as it enters the battlefield.
You control at least one additional creature.
4694-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
The Blood token enters the battlefield as a 0/0 creature due to March of the Machines, and will have its toughness boosted by the permanent specified in the pre-requisites to prevent it from dying.
Repeat.

1247-5536-5832.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness and has at least one level counter on it.
Joraga Treespeaker and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-5536-5832.description:
Activate Rex using Joraga Treespeaker's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1339-5256-5572.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-5256-5572.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Pakpatiq, Deepest Epoch // Temple of Cyclical Time

2034-5550-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2034-5550-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazotep Convert, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Repeat from step 4.

500-2021-3112.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other creatures with +1/+1 counters on them.
500-2021-3112.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Slurrk and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one Slurrk token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Slurrk triggers once, and Simic Ascendancy's first ability triggers twice.
Resolve both Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting ten growth counters on it.
Resolve the first Slurrk trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Simic Ascendacy's first ability triggers for each counter placed this way, putting that many growth counters on it.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Simic Ascendancy's second ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

244-1840-1912-2544.description:
Cast False Dawn by paying {1}{W}.
Activate Component Pouch's second ability by tapping it, causing you to roll a d20 and put at least one component counter on it.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, or by paying {W} due to False Dawn, untapping Component Pouch.
Activate Component Pouch's first ability by tapping it and removing a component counter from it, adding {W}{W} which can be spent as mana of any color due to False Dawn.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {W}, untapping Component Pouch.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite component counters on Component Pouch, you may forego steps 2 and 3 to get infinite colored mana.

1729-2439-4762.notablePrerequisites: Shelob and Ulvenwald Tracker do not have summoning sickness.
1729-2439-4762.description:
Activate Ulvenwald Tracker by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing Shelob to fight Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid dies as a state-based action due to Shelob's deathtouch.
Shelob triggers, creating a token copy of Devoted Druid that is a Food artifact.
Activate the Devoted Druid token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Devoted Druid token by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 4.

860-3018-4050-4186.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
860-3018-4050-4186.description:
Cast Rancor by paying {G}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When Rancor enters the battlefield, Calix's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Rancor attached, adding {G}.
Rancor triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2736-3903-3958.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Moderation to an opponent.
Whenever the opponent that controls Moderation casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Moderation prevents the opponent from casting more than one spell each turn, the opponent cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

3387-3444-3781-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skylasher, adding {G}.
Zask triggers.
In response, cast Skylasher from your graveyard by paying {G}.
Ronas's Monument triggers, giving target creature you control +2/+2 and trample until end of turn.
Skylasher enters the battlefield.
Resolve Zask's trigger, milling two cards.
Repeat.

1458-2757-4122.notablePrerequisites:
You have a green creature card in hand that can be cast using {G}.
You control a basic Forest.
Nettle Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
1458-2757-4122.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting Nettle Sentinel.
Cast the green creature card from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Nettle Sentinel triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the green creature, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nettle Sentinel by tapping it, returning the green creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1193-4095-4477.notablePrerequisites: Enough lands or other mana producers total among all players which can be activated the turn they enter the battlefield to produce at least {3} {R} {R} (this condition is trivially easy).
1193-4095-4477.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna targeting anything but Greenwarden, holding priority, and then cast Radiate targeting Mythos of Illuna.
When Radiate resolves you will have Mythos copies targeting every targetable permanent (except what the original Mythos card is targeting).
When each of the copies resolve, target Radiate in your graveyard with the new Greenwarden token's ability and return Radiate to your hand.
Before the original Mythos of Illuna card resolves, cast Radiate again targeting Mythos by spending mana from the tokens you just created.
Repeat this process, effectively doubling the number of copies created, allowing you to return Radiate and another card with two Greenwarden triggers.
Repeat.
